findings.change: When U1b1b or U2b2 makes a delegated class live, either bind the decision id to the act's argv or remove METASYSTEM_DECISION from the environment before starting a long-lived descendant.
findings.claim: METASYSTEM_DECISION is inherited by every process the decision's child starts. A long-lived descendant in the main session's process tree, such as a keeper or a detached run, would still carry the decision id. It could later be admitted for a delegated class under a decision that was never recorded for that act.
findings.evidence: intent_decision.go:158 appends the variable to the child's environment. attorney_admits.go:209-214 checks only that it is present and has no spaces, never that a decision record with that id exists. Today no delegated class reaches an effect: there is no budget route, work stop run: requires a direct person proof, and the lane verbs refuse grants. No reproduction or traced path, so this is noted only.
findings.relation: rule: a delegated act runs only inside its decision record (design D2)

findings.change: None needed now. The help text could name reason beside classes in its rebuild warning.
findings.claim: Every new general grant now writes reason= and may name a new class. An engine that has not been rebuilt refuses the reason key and the new classes when it reads such a grant line, so a seat still on an old engine cannot read the ledger.
findings.evidence: The base engine's parseAttorneyEntry accepts a closed list of keys, and reason is not on it (base root.go). general_attorney.go:62 always sets Reason, defaulting to 'no reason given'. The grant add help already says to rebuild every seat's engine before the first grant with classes. Central delivery (R-151-m1e) and the goal's NextStep (grant only after the units deploy) bound this window.
findings.relation: rule: engines older than a ledger refuse it (existing classes precedent)
